items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the teacher would look at my name and say “Bonli, Bonie, Boni- Forborni, Borni.”

ctx.x: And people take the wildest stabs and they always get it wrong.

Yeah the trouble is that, I’m Buddy because it’s when I went to school, first went to school; the teacher would look at my name and say “Bonli, Bonie, Boni- Forborni, Borni.” And all the kids would giggle and laugh and I’d be embarrassed. So it
wasn’t long before my family finally said, “Buddy.” Buddy, lets keep it Buddy. We don’t need all that.
